title: Custom eggless cakes ready before 7am — Box Hill and Vineyard drop-offs
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not an accident — it's for the Box Hill and Vineyard parents doing a school drop-off before a cake pickup, not after.

Every cake is 100% eggless. Not some cakes, every cake. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, buttercream, fondant or ganache, any design from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre, Shop 8.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
